source: MAFF / ADB, "ដំណាំសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean crop], official cultivation manual, 2005
text: Pest coverage lists armyworm, cutworm, bean pod borer, leaf-footed bug/stink bug complex, aphid, thrips, leafhopper, and bruchid weevil (a storage pest attacking dried seed), with identification notes and general chemical/cultural control guidance for each. The manual pairs cultural practices (field sanitation, timely harvest to avoid pod-shattering losses that also reduce the bruchid weevil's food source in the field) with targeted spraying only when pest levels are damaging.
